query: What are the common advantage attributes of airlines whose overall rating is high?

per_column.name: cabin_crew_attitude
per_column.rationale: Onboard crew demeanor is a concrete part of the in-flight service dimension that constitutes an airline's offering, hence a meronymic aspect OF competitive advantage.

per_column.name: ground_service_quality
per_column.rationale: Check-in/boarding/airport service is a distinct constitutive part of the overall service experience an airline provides, an aspect OF the concept.

per_column.name: service_proactivity
per_column.rationale: Proactivity is a genuine service quality aspect, but it overlaps directly with cabin_crew_attitude's 'warm_proactive' value and with service_consistency, so as a facet it is not cleanly separated from the other service columns.

per_column.name: service_consistency
per_column.rationale: Reliability/consistency is an aspect of the service dimension, but it is a cross-cutting meta-property that spans crew, ground and customer service rather than a disjoint part, so it blurs the boundaries between the other service facets.

per_column.name: food_quality
per_column.rationale: Catering is a clear constitutive part of the in-flight product an airline competes on; an aspect OF the offering.

per_column.name: seat_comfort_assessment
per_column.rationale: Seat/cabin comfort is a core constitutive product facet of the flying experience and thus a part-of the competitive advantage.

per_column.name: baggage_handling_outcome
per_column.rationale: Baggage handling is an operational service component of what the airline delivers, a distinct constitutive aspect OF the concept.

per_column.name: customer_service_responsiveness
per_column.rationale: Post/pre-flight customer support responsiveness is a service facet, though it partially overlaps with ground_service_quality and refund_rebooking_handling.

per_column.name: refund_rebooking_handling
per_column.rationale: Disruption/refund handling is a specific service facet, but it is largely a sub-aspect of customer_service_responsiveness, creating overlap rather than a clean partition.

per_column.name: value_for_money_perception
per_column.rationale: Value-for-money is a holistic quality-per-price judgement that aggregates across all the other facets; it summarizes the whole competitive-advantage concept (and duplicates the existing 'Value For Money' column) rather than being one disjoint part OF it.

judge.rationale: Most columns are genuine meronymic facets of an airline's product/service offering, which is what constitutes competitive advantage, so the part-of relationship holds for 9 of 10. However mutual exclusivity is weakened by heavy overlap within the service cluster: service_proactivity duplicates the 'warm_proactive' aspect of cabin_crew_attitude, service_consistency is a cross-cutting meta-property spanning the other service columns, and refund_rebooking_handling is essentially a sub-case of customer_service_responsiveness. value_for_money_perception is not a part but a holistic restatement of the whole concept. Exhaustiveness is moderate: coverage skews strongly toward service (6-7 of 10 columns) while under-representing product/operational facets — notably absent are inflight entertainment (present in the source table), on-time/punctuality performance, network/schedule, and loyalty program — so the decomposition covers many but not all main constitutive aspects and is unbalanced.
